bulgaria.title: Flag of the Republic of Bulgaria

colors.note: Symbolises agricultural wealth, freedom, and Bulgaria's fertile land.
Represents the courage and blood shed by Bulgarian soldiers during the struggle for independence.

desc:
- Three horizontal bands of equal width in white, green, and red from top to bottom
- First adopted in 1879 after independence from Ottoman rule; re-confirmed in the 1991 post-communist constitution
- The 1991 revision removed the communist-era state emblem from the white band
trivia:
- The tricolour draws on pan-Slavic colours introduced after Russia helped Bulgaria win independence in 1878
- Between 1947 and 1990 the flag bore the communist state emblem on the white stripe
- Bulgaria's flag law prohibits damaging, soiling, or otherwise desecrating the national flag
